title: Build automated validation harness and CI
description:
Replace the single placeholder extension test with a layered, deterministic safety net that can prove every remediation. Tests must not call live third-party APIs and must never be skipped or weakened to conceal failures.

Add explicit scripts for extension and webview type-checking, Node unit tests, deterministic localhost HTTP integration tests, compiled extension-host tests, development/production builds, audit checks, and VSIX packaging. Refactor only the boundaries needed to test domain logic without loading VS Code. Extend ESLint to `webview-ui` TypeScript/TSX and make warnings fail the build.

CI should use `npm ci`, cache only npm's download cache, run the complete validation sequence, execute VS Code tests under a supported display environment, and package an artifact. Tests need fixtures for transport, variables, storage corruption/migrations, collection round trips, cURL, code generation, protocol validation, SecretStorage, cancellation, and stale responses.

checklist.text: Add explicit scripts for both type-checks, unit tests, HTTP integration tests, extension tests, builds, audits, and packaging
Create Node unit-test boundaries for variables, collections, parsing, generation, validation, and persistence
Create deterministic localhost HTTP fixtures covering methods, bodies, redirects, compression, limits, timing, timeout, and cancellation
Add storage corruption, migration, concurrency, import/export, redaction, and SecretStorage regression fixtures
Add extension-host coverage for activation, commands, webview lifecycle, queued startup actions, and protocol errors
Lint src and webview TS/TSX with zero warnings and preserve strict TypeScript checks
Add CI that performs clean install, complete validation, VS Code tests, audits, and production packaging
Document exact local and CI commands plus any minimum-VS-Code platform limitation
